1234. Dynamic Circular Buffer

80

Hard

Problem Statement:
Create a circular buffer using dynamic memory allocation. The buffer should support adding elements, removing elements, and checking if it is full or empty. You must handle the dynamic resizing of the buffer when it is full or if it is resized.

Implement a circular buffer that can grow and shrink dynamically.
Handle cases where the buffer needs resizing using realloc.
Properly manage memory using malloc, calloc, realloc, and free.
input_spec:
An integer n indicating the number of operations.
For each operation, you will receive:
An operation type (ADD, REMOVE, RESIZE).
Depending on the operation, additional parameters such as the value to add, or the new size for resizing.
output_spec: After each operation, print the current state of the buffer.
